title: Appointed as Assistant
original: Feel free to assign any work to me. I have a lot of experience as a second-in-command.

title: Talk 1
original: This communicator transmits signals over long distances, it's a powerful tool for keeping teams in touch. My Arts even amplify the signal, ensuring that communication between teams goes unimpeded. Honestly, battlefield communication is a job that was practically made for me.

title: Talk 2
original: Lost? No worries, tell me where you wanna go. Um, to get there, first go up the stairs on the left until you reach the fourth floor. Then turn right, and after passing the third fork, make a left. Go down a floor, then proceed to your left. It's directly across from Closure's #3 Engineering Room. How's that? Aren't my instructions clear and concise?

title: Talk 3
original: Thorns and I have reached an agreement: Next time, neither of us will hold back, and a victor will be crowned. I'll be sure to defeat him by a landside... What? Rhodes Island has an explicit ban on personal fights? You misunderstand, I'm only talking about chess. Loser has to shave his head, what say you to this bet?

title: Talk after Promotion 1
original: To be honest, I'm not used to being someone else's assistant. But since my captain relies solely on me to deliver her orders, I have to stay on the squad to support her. Oh, that's just between you and me, by the way. For both our sakes, don't ever tell her what I just told you, okay?

title: Talk after Promotion 2
original: There's no overstating the importance of communication on the battlefield. And of course, the one facilitating it is the first to get targeted. But don't worry, as long as I'm here, I'll make sure your orders are smoothly transmitted to all combat personnel.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
original: Doctor, you came right on time. Actually, there's something bothering me. Why does everyone prefer looking at a map over asking me for directions? The captain says my glib tone gets on people's nerves. But that can't be, I always treat everyone with perfect kindness, wouldn't you agree?

title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
original: On the battlefield, few things are more important than morale. Do you see this banner? As a vanguard, just lifting it is enough to fill everyone with courage. Wait, Doctor, you didn't seriously believe that, did you? I was just joking, this thing's actually a communication device.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
original: Doctor, you've earned my trust. There's no need to be so humble. I know I'm a good judge of character. How about I call you my comrade-in-arms from now on? My captain and I used to be like oil and water, but look at us now. I believe that, much like her, you will eventually be moved by my sincerity. No? The captain sent you a letter complaining about me? What?

title: Idle
original: Doctor, the files over here are... Hm? Already asleep? Well, even if it's just me, you really shouldn't let your guard down like that.

title: Onboard
original: 3rd Combat Squad, vanguard and communications specialist, Elysium, reporting in. We've always communicated through electronic means, I do believe this is our first time speaking face-to-face, Doctor?

title: Watching Battle Record
original: I'm seeing myself in a lot of these battle records. Talk about weird.

title: Promotion 1
original: Thank you very much. I won't end up ranked higher than my captain if I get promoted again, will I?

title: Promotion 2
original: I've always trusted my own judgment, Doctor. But if you're the one giving me orders, I won't question them for a second. After all, isn't that what it means to be a comrade-in-arms?

title: Added to Squad
original: Of course, I'd love to.

title: Appointed as Squad Leader
original: Don't worry, I'm just a stand-in. The captain's not here right now, after all.

title: Depart
original: Let's go then. Everyone, follow the route I drafted.

title: Begin Operation
original: Check your headsets, people.

title: Selecting Operator 1
original: No problem.

title: Selecting Operator 2
original: Signal stable. Ready for action.

title: Deployment 1
original: I wonder who their target will be.

title: Deployment 2
original: Gather under this banner in the name of the Lord— Heh, I've always wanted to try saying that.

title: In Battle 1
original: Sorry, but I'm really not religious.

title: In Battle 2
original: Who would! Use a flag! As a weapon on the battlefield!

title: In Battle 3
original: Now we'll see them!

title: In Battle 4
original: Let's get this done quick!

title: 4-star Result
original: This just confirms it. We really do make the best partners.

title: 3-star Result
original: Great teamwork. Give me five!

title: Sub 3-star Result
original: If they've lost their fighting spirit, they're not our enemies anymore. Let's stop here.

title: Operation Failure
original: It's too dangerous! I'll be the last line of defense! Doctor, please give the order to retreat!

title: Assigned to Facility
original: Hm... Has this room been renovated?

title: Tap
original: What's up?

title: Trust Tap
original: I've heard that if this tuft of red hair on my head falls out, it won't ever grow back. This is a very serious problem, Doctor.

title: Title
original: Arknights.

title: New Year's blessing
original: Hello, hello? Can you hear me...? Signal's fine, connection to the landship's all clear. Doctor, try to guess which comms station I'm calling from...? Doc's distracted! Now! Set off the fireworks! Heh-heh, what do you think, Doctor? Now that's a passionate New Year's celebration, isn't it?

title: Greeting
original: Hey, Doctor! Got any missions for me today?

title: Birthday
original: Happy birthday, Doctor. I've meticulously prepared this year's gift, taking into consideration everything I've learned. This time, you'll be blown away by... W-Wait, hold on, Doctor, don't leave! I swear, it's not a prank this time!

title: Anniversary Celebration
original: Rhodes Island's a lot busier now than when I first arrived. We keep finding more and more trustworthy companions, and I think I'm not the only one drawing complaints anymore. I'm deeply moved, so I painstakingly edited up an audio reel of everyone being drunk at last year's party! I hope it gets some enthusiastic reactions!
